en:
Let's go over the trick that <CLT=cltSTRONG>Kokichi and
the culprit<CLT=cltNORMAL> created together...

Last night, Keebo saw <CLT=cltSTRONG>Himiko<CLT=cltNORMAL>
from the window of his lab.

She was carrying a <CLT=cltSTRONG>black case<CLT=cltNORMAL>
and <CLT=cltSTRONG>heading to the Exisal hangar<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

When she reached the hangar, she handed the case
to someone through the <CLT=cltSTRONG>bathroom window<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

That <CLT=cltSTRONG>someone<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
is the culprit of this case!

Locked in the bathroom, the culprit had asked
Himiko to bring them a <CLT=cltSTRONG>certain weapon<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
A <CLT=cltSTRONG>disassembled crossbow<CLT=cltNORMAL> from Maki's lab.

The culprit was going to use the crossbow
to challenge Kokichi to a fight.

Some time passed, and <CLT=cltSTRONG>Maki<CLT=cltNORMAL> made her way
to the hangar.

She was going to the hangar to kill Kokichi
and save the culprit trapped in the bathroom.

However, the hangar had an <CLT=cltSTRONG>electric
barrier<CLT=cltNORMAL> preventing her from entering.

Fortunately for her, she had an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Electrohammer<CLT=cltNORMAL>
to get around the barrier...in a way.

She used her Electrohammer to disable
an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Exisal<CLT=cltNORMAL> and <CLT=cltSTRONG>climbed inside<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

She knew Exisals could bypass the barrier...
so she got inside one!

Around that time, the culprit and Kokichi
began their confrontation.

While Kokichi was checking up on them, the
culprit ambushed him with the crossbow.

But the culprit didn't intend to kill
Kokichi, they just wanted to disable him.

That's why the culprit aimed for
Kokichi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>right arm<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

If they really wanted to kill him, they would
have shot him in his vitals.

Kokichi reeled from the arrow, and the
culprit jumped on him immediately.

He didn't want Kokichi to have the chance
to summon an Exisal with the <CLT=cltSTRONG>remote<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

While they were fighting, something happened
that caught them both off guard.

The shutter of the hangar opened,
and an Exisal stepped inside!

Kokichi was definitely not expecting an
Exisal to interrupt them.

He pulled out his remote in an
attempt to control the Exisal...

But Maki leaped out of the cockpit
and shot Kokichi with her crossbow.

The arrow hit Kokichi right in the <CLT=cltSTRONG>back<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
And it was no normal arrow.

The tip was covered in a lethal poison from
my lab called <CLT=cltSTRONG>Strike-9 Poison<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The poison kills slowly. It seems as if Maki
wanted Kokichi to confess before he died.

But even with poison in his veins,
Kokichi continued to spin his lies.

When she had had enough, Maki tried to finish
him off with another poisoned arrow...

...but this time, Maki was the
one caught by surprise.

To keep Maki from becoming the blackened,
the culprit used their body to <CLT=cltSTRONG>shield Kokichi<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The culprit's <CLT=cltSTRONG>left arm<CLT=cltNORMAL> was struck by a poison
arrow.

Maki remembered that there was an <CLT=cltSTRONG>antidote<CLT=cltNORMAL>
in my lab, and immediately ran off to get it.

The Strike-9 Poison slowly circulated through
their systems, and would soon kill them both.

But in that desperate situation,
Kokichi thought up a clever <CLT=cltSTRONG>lie<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

He incorporated this unforeseen event into
his plan to help him win the killing game!
Or, should I say...help him <CLT=cltSTRONG>defeat Monokuma<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

That was Kokichi's true objective. It's why
he claimed to be the <CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Thinking fast, Kokichi closed the shutter
so that Maki could not re-enter the hangar.
Thus Kokichi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>final lie<CLT=cltNORMAL> was set into motion.

When Maki returned with the antidote, she
couldn't get back inside the hangar...

...so she went around to the hangar bathroom
and passed the antidote through the window.

But after the culprit was given the antidote,
Kokichi immediately snatched it.

Kokichi drank down all of the antidote while
the culprit and Maki watched in horror.

Maki must have been panicking, thinking
the only antidote was now gone.

She believed that the culprit was going to
die from her own poisoned arrow.

But it was all another one of <CLT=cltSTRONG>Kokichi's lies<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
He had only pretended to drink the antidote.

Maki tried desperately to break into the hangar,
even slashing the control panel.

But she couldn't get the shutter to open again.
Defeated, she had no choice but to leave.

After Maki had left, Kokichi took out another
weapon.

An <CLT=cltSTRONG>Electrobomb<CLT=cltNORMAL> capable of disabling
communication devices for hours.

Kokichi's plan was to use an Electrobomb to
knock out Monokuma's surveillance cameras.

That was why he commissioned Miu
to make the bombs in the first place.

After detonating an Electrobomb, Kokichi
coerced the culprit into drinking the antidote.

In exchange for the antidote, Kokichi asked
the culprit to cooperate with his plan.

Kokichi needed to work with the culprit
to execute his final lie.

Under normal circumstances, the culprit
would never have agreed to such a plan...

But because the culprit owed him for saving
their life, they agreed to Kokichi's request.

Ah, "request" is a generous term.
It was more like blackmail.

In any case, the two were now working
together as <CLT=cltSTRONG>accomplices<CLT=cltNORMAL> in an insane plan.

There was a lot to prepare, and not a lot
of time.

They had to work fast. If Kokichi died from the
Strike-9 Poison, the whole plan would be ruined.

After fabricating the scene in the bathroom, the
culprit dragged Kokichi to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>hydraulic press<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

This is how the <CLT=cltSTRONG>swipe pattern bloodstain<CLT=cltNORMAL> from
the bathroom to the press was created.

Kokichi, with the support of the culprit, stood
in front of the press's <CLT=cltSTRONG>control panel<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The two of them were finally ready
to execute the insane lie!

While Kokichi was setting up the <CLT=cltSTRONG>video camera<CLT=cltNORMAL>
near the hydraulic press's control panel...

the culprit laid <CLT=cltSTRONG>face up<CLT=cltNORMAL> inside the press,
draping their coat <CLT=cltSTRONG>over their shoulders<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Then, Kokichi activated the <CLT=cltSTRONG>press<CLT=cltNORMAL> and the
camera's <CLT=cltSTRONG>record button<CLT=cltNORMAL> at the same time...

The hydraulic press came down slowly,
all caught on tape for us to see.

Normally the <CLT=cltSTRONG>safety function<CLT=cltNORMAL> would have
triggered, but the Electrobomb had disabled it.

The press got lower and lower, and just as
the culprit disappeared from view...

Kokichi pressed the "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Force Stop<CLT=cltNORMAL>" button and
the camera's <CLT=cltSTRONG>pause button<CLT=cltNORMAL> simultaneously.

The two then switched places...and also
switched <CLT=cltSTRONG>roles<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
The "culprit"...and the "victim."

The would-be victim became our culprit and
started up the press and camera.

Kokichi had saved the culprit's life because
his trick required their cooperation.

He wanted to win the killing game...
even if it meant dying himself!

And so, Kokichi was crushed by the press,
and the whole thing was caught on <CLT=cltSTRONG>video<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>culprit's left sleeve<CLT=cltNORMAL> was dangling from
the press, making us think he was the victim.

Now alone, the culprit collected the video
camera...

...and tore the hydraulic press's power cord,
so that it could never be raised again.

This would make it impossible for us to
determine the identity of the crushed body.

But there was another reason the
victim was killed in this way...

It obfuscated the <CLT=cltSTRONG>cause of death<CLT=cltNORMAL>, making
the case that much more difficult to solve.

This was all part of Kokichi's plan to create a
<CLT=cltSTRONG>murder not even Monokuma could figure out<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

With the press disabled, the culprit returned
to the bathroom to flush Kokichi's clothes.

Finally, they climbed inside of an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Exisal<CLT=cltNORMAL>
to hide...and waited with bated breath.

And here they are now in this trial,
pretending to be Kokichi.

They're trying to deceive Monokuma
in order to defeat the true mastermind!

...And that's it. That's Kokichi's
Unidentified Culprit Trick.

The culprit is in that Exisal.
...It's you, isn't it?
...<CLT=cltSTRONG>Kaito Momota, the Ultimate Astronaut<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
